title: An ample line bundle has an affine section neighbourhood of a finite set
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal M$ an ample invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], $E\subseteq Y$ a finite set of points, and $W\subseteq Y$ open with $E\subseteq W$. There are $n>0$ and $s\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal M^{\otimes n})$ with $E\subseteq Y_s\subseteq W$ and $Y_s$ affine.

proof.text: Choose an affine open A containing E by [lem-sc-ample-finite-set-affine]. Let B = A intersect W, and choose J with support Y minus B using [lem-sc-closed-subset-qc-ideal].

Insert each section from the ampleness cover into its single homogeneous summand of the section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Apply [lem-sc-ample-proj-canonical-map] to obtain f from Y to Proj of this ring. Define p_y to be the homogeneous prime represented by f(y). The inverse-image formula gives, for positive-degree homogeneous x, x in p_y if and only if y is outside the nonvanishing locus of its degree component. Define I to be the intersection of the irrelevant ideal and all p_z with z outside B. This is a homogeneous ideal contained in the irrelevant ideal.

Prove locally that an image section of J tensor N, for invertible N, vanishes on the support of J. Use the sheaf-level invertibility comparison [lem-pc-invertible-sheaf-instance] and a local affine free generator e of N. The existing proved TensorSection.IsFreeGenerator.bijective_tmulSection_right writes the restricted tensor section as a tensor e with a section a of J. Its image is c times e, where c is the image of a and belongs to J.ideal on this affine open by the proved range_toModulesι_app. A support point is in the zero locus of this ideal, so the germ of c is a nonunit and lies in the maximal ideal. Germ compatibility with restrictions and scalar action puts the image section in the maximal ideal times the stalk. These are existing proved library and Mathlib calculations, implemented explicitly in the local Lean proof.

For y in B, the support equality says y is outside J. Supply CompactSpace Y from ampleness and apply [lem-sc-ample-ideal-section]. The resulting positive-power section is nonvanishing at y, and the preceding local calculation shows its locus is contained in B. Insert it into the section ring: its positive degree puts it in the irrelevant ideal, and vanishing outside B puts it in all p_z there, hence in I. It is outside p_y, proving I is not contained in p_y. Enumerate the finite set E by Fin(card E) and apply [lem-sc-graded-prime-avoidance] to obtain positive-degree homogeneous x in I avoiding every point prime of E.

Take s to be the degree-n component of x. Prime membership shows its nonvanishing locus contains E and is contained in B. Apply the positive-power clause of [lem-sc-affine-cap-section-open] on A. Since the locus is contained in A, the affine intersection open is exactly the entire nonvanishing locus; it is contained in W. The same finite enumeration and prime-avoidance application works for E empty, with no separate choice or nonemptiness assumption.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affine_section_neighbourhood_of_finite (Y : Scheme.{u}) (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] (hM : IsAmple Y M) (E : Set Y) (hE : E.Finite) (W : Y.Opens) (hEW : E ⊆ (W : Set Y)) : ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ s : (M.tensorPow n).val.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤), ∃ U : Y.Opens, E ⊆ (U : Set Y) ∧ U ≤ W ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧ ∀ y : Y, y ∈ U ↔ (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (M.tensorPow n).val.presheaf ⊤ y trivial) s ∉ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) • (⊤ : Submodule (Y.presheaf.stalk y) ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (M.tensorPow n).val.presheaf y))
